shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright stone shaft/pillar
schematic figural motif set on a flat frontal panel
smaller subsidiary motifs arranged below the main motif
justification: Both surfaces show shallow, flattened low-relief motifs laid out frontally on a tall upright shaft, with a dominant motif in the upper field and smaller subsidiary carvings stacked beneath it, and both render forms schematically in raised outline with little interior modelling. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A shows an anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms folded across the torso and a disc/rosette on the chest plus banded geometric motifs, while B shows a striding quadruped in strict profile above other small creatures, with no human form or disc-on-chest at all.
